title: Run defaults proposals automatically after introspection and at drain
summary: Make `Athena::propose` run without a separate command: after each introspection is recorded, and once at the start of `athena drain`, so pending proposals show in `athena status` and in-limit ones are approved and worked by drain's existing steward path. Audience: the maintainer who reads status and the verifier running cargo test.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for threshold, no re-proposal, status listing; clippy clean.
Criteria check proposals appearing from introspection/drain, not wiring.
Behavior criteria runnable via cargo test.
One focused hook change reusing Athena::propose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: crates/athena-core/src/propose.rs does not exist; the logic is in proposals.rs (Athena::propose, generate), so that file is the one modified.

Automatic proposing is hooked in introspect_job/introspect_intervention (never-failing wrappers) and a new Steps method called at drain start; existing generate rules (threshold, no repeat for pending/rejected classes) are kept as is.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test (run with cargo test) records an introspection that brings a failure class to the distinct-job threshold and then finds a pending defaults proposal, without calling `athena propose` separately.
A test (cargo test) shows a class that already has a pending/accepted proposal, or was rejected with no N newer distinct jobs, gets no new proposal after another introspection or drain start.
A test (cargo test) shows the status output lists the automatically created proposal.
A drain test (cargo test) shows propose runs at drain start, and an in-limit proposal is then approved and worked under the existing steward limit; an above-limit one is listed as waiting.
A failure inside automatic proposing only prints a line and never fails the introspection or the drain; cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing automatic proposing; docs of the introspect/drain modules mention it. defaults.toml, athena.toml and workflows are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Changing the proposal threshold or the generation/rejection rules
Editing defaults.toml or accepting proposals automatically beyond the existing steward ladder
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass odds: touches introspection, the drain Steps trait and its test doubles, and the named propose.rs does not exist.
